aggregates.blocker_count_histogram_basis: rejected = candidates with at least one *hard* blocker (exact 3D distance < 0.05 mm, strict-D56 conflict or self clearance); near-miss = guard-flagged only by the 0.061 mm sampling safety margin, exact distance still >= 0.05 mm

route129.verdict: the net=16 candidate is rejected by the production guard at every target height. Physically (exact 3D < 0.05 mm) L4 has no hard blocker (near-miss only) and L8 has exactly one hard blocker (r120, an L7 flat right above the excursion start); all other target heights need 2-5 hard blockers, and L15/L19/Z1/Z2 additionally hit target-plane strict-D56 conflicts. A single mid-body excursion cannot be accepted as-is; the cheapest route is L4/L8 + exact handling of the near-miss pairs (+ moving r120 for L8).
